unit.why: It praises the master's books and his devekut while writing, then tells a short anecdote: a famous tzaddik spent Shabbat with him and afterwards expounded his teaching at length.
unit.boundary_note: Part of a numbered series of praises (ט) about the same master; preceded by (ח) and followed by (י).

stories.start_quote: וספריו הקדושים עמוק עמוק מי ימצאנו
stories.summary_en: The master's writings are so deep, written in near self-annihilating devekut, that a famous kabbalist-tzaddik who spent Shabbat with him said one of his table-teachings would take him years to explain.

quotes: הי' דבוק בחי העולמים עד אין סוף
tags.why: He wrote his book in rapt cleaving to God.
Mystical self-annihilation in communion with God.
His words were spoken in awe.

quotes: ונפשו יצאה בדברו כברקים ולפידים ממש
הי' שם משובתי שבת צדיק וקדוש מפורסם
ואחר סעודת שבת בלכתו לאכסניא שלו
tags.why: The anecdote is set on Shabbat.

quotes: דיבר מהתורה שאמר מורינו הנ"ל על שלחנו הטהור
tags.why: A Torah teaching given at the table and expounded afterwards.

quotes: הי' שם משובתי שבת צדיק וקדוש מפורסם
tags.why: Another famous tzaddik came to spend Shabbat with the master.

quotes: וגאון ומקובל אלקי אשר כל רז לא אנס ליה
tags.why: A kabbalist uncovers the hidden depth of the teaching.
The anecdote illustrates the master's spiritual greatness.

quotes: ואמר שיש לו על כמה שנים לפרש
tags.why: One tzaddik expresses esteem for another.
